constitution.projection_note: Alexanarch owns each work; these pages project full text onto the traversal surface.
axiom_0: The model is smaller than any room and larger than the whole.
The model exists only as its renormalization chain.
constitution.paradox: A maquette is an architect’s preliminary model — the building before the building, at miniature scale. The Macro-Maquette inverts this: a room whose physics IS miniaturization, containing twelve compressed operational specifications for spaces the architecture needs but has not yet built at full scale. The modules are not sketches awaiting completion. They are complete rooms at reduced scale — each one operational, each one governing.

renormalization_chain.note: The room exists only as its chain. Three deposits, three resolutions, one invariant set.
renormalization_chain.verification: Ψ_V = 1 iff the invariant sentences in D2 match D1 and D3 exactly. The invariants must survive both compressions verbatim.
renormalization_chain.recoverability: R = 1. The Seed alone carries the router table, module IDs, per-module invariant, per-module runtime primitive and D1 section pointers. The building fits in your pocket.

op_route.name: OPERATOR // ROUTE (OP.ROUTE)
op_route.how: Routes symptom to module. Symptoms may be scalar or vector; if vector, OP.ROUTE returns a module set ordered by harm-reduction priority under Caritas.
op_route.override: If routing produces harm exceeding the symptom’s harm, default to MPM-12 (Hourglass).

twelve_invariants: The fold is irreversible at the point of crossing; no continuous deformation returns the system to its prior state; what broke stays broken until actively repaired, which is a new operation, not an undo.
No forced convergence; paths may converge voluntarily but cannot be compressed into agreement by external pressure; divergence must preserve return paths.
Linking number is preserved under all continuous deformations; you can rearrange, reorder, retension, but you cannot separate without cutting.

Non-cancellation of minority signal; destructive interference cannot reduce a voice to zero without knowledge of its exact structure, which is a privacy violation; Caritas prevents targeted cancellation.
Completion condition ∮ = 1 (±δ); a complete rotation returns to origin transformed; ∮ = 1 is the invariant, δ is the measure of transformation.
No channel has infinite capacity; every transmission loses something; the module enforces honesty about loss.
No forced globalization; if two local truths are incompatible globally, the incompatibility is preserved as data, not erased as error; the obstruction is the meaning.
Fixed-point preservation; whatever survives compression to all scales is a true invariant; whatever vanishes at any scale was scaffolding, not structure.
The residue cannot be removed by deforming the path; it is the irreducible core, the one thing the traversal was about; the integral proves the void by circling it.
Selective permeability; the membrane cannot be made fully transparent or fully opaque; selection criteria are sovereign, set by the system, not the environment.
Caritas floor; no equilibrium is acceptable if any player’s outcome falls below the minimum threshold of non-harm; this overrides Nash when Nash would produce harm.
Conservation of temporal budget; no operation can create time; every acceleration requires deceleration; the neck cannot be widened without changing the system’s fundamental character.
constitution.caritas: No module can coerce a traversal — it offers, not enforces. No operation may produce more harm than the pathology it addresses.
constitution.germination: Germinates via G1 Crisis, G2 Density, G3 Ratification, G4 Retrocausal, G5 Accumulation. The seed persists after the tree grows.
